items.title: 'Like opening an oven': NT constable praised for 'heroic' rescue attempt
items.description: A "heroic" Alice Springs police officer who risked his life repeatedly entering a burning building in trying to rescue a three-year-old boy will be awarded a medal of valour.

items.title: Live: Watson involved in fiery scuffle as Dogs roar back after slow start
items.description: Cody Weightman plays his first match since 2024 as the Bulldogs face the Hawks at the MCG. Follow live.

items.title: Woman stabbed by ex says warning signs 'should have been enough'
items.description: A judge said Anthony Monteleone was "utterly delusional" in repeated messages to the woman before attacking her outside a Sydney gym in 2024.

items.title: Live: Roosters superstar making red-hot return against Raiders in Canberra
items.description: Mark Nawaqanitawase crosses twice in a dominant first half for the Roosters, after Melbourne hangs on for a 32-30 victory over Newcastle. Follow live.

items.title: ASIC names two KPMG partners it is formally investigating over audit scandal
items.description: ASIC tells a Senate estimates committee it is formally investigating KPMG and that it still has eight current contracts with the firm.

items.title: PM admits One Nation's rise influenced decision to overhaul tax system
items.description: The rise of One Nation is partly behind the government's decision to take on tax reform in this year's budget, the prime minister has admitted.

items.title: Mongols bikie escapes custody after scaling court dock, dashing past security
items.description: A manhunt is under way in Darwin as police search for Brandt Graham, a 44-year-old Mongols bikie who scaled an enclosed courthouse dock and escaped from custody today.

items.title: Flu numbers are down for now – this could be why
items.description: Flu cases have come down since the record-breaking 2025 season but experts warn against a "false sense of security".

items.title: Sydney police officer sentenced over death of Indigenous 16yo
items.description: A NSW Police officer convicted over a fatal collision that killed an Indigenous teenager has avoided time behind bars.

items.title: Sunscreens that failed to meet SPF claims still under investigation
items.description: Most of the sunscreens that failed to meet their SPF label claims, according to independent testing, are still under investigation by the regulator one year later.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
items.description: President Trump states the U.S. military conducted its first known airstrike inside Venezuela targeting a dock where drugs were allegedly loaded onto boats[1][2][4].

items.title: Trump Meets Netanyahu at Mar-a-Lago for Gaza Ceasefire Phase Two Talks
items.description: President Trump met with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu to discuss advancing phase two of the Gaza ceasefire, including reconstruction and responses to Iran[1][4].

items.title: Feds Launch Massive Taxpayer Fraud Probe in Minnesota After Viral Video
items.description: Federal agencies including DHS, FBI, and ICE investigate $110 million in suspected fraud at Minnesota child care centers following a viral YouTube video[3].

items.title: Americans Express Widespread Opposition to AI Data Centers
items.description: Public backlash against AI infrastructure data centers grows, with protests and demands for bans influencing Democratic Party strategies for future elections[3].

items.title: Elon Musk's Humanoid Robot Vision: China Poised to Lead Production
items.description: China prioritizes humanoid robots in tech race with U.S., ramping up production while warning of industry bubble and potential bottlenecks[3].

items.title: Trump-Putin Call Amid Ukraine-Russia Tensions Over Peace Plan
items.description: President Trump spoke with Putin amid ongoing Ukraine conflict, with Russia reevaluating peace plan tenets after Ukrainian denials[1].

items.title: Democratic Gubernatorial Candidates in Wisconsin Focus on Inflation and Trump
items.description: Seven Democrats vying for Wisconsin governor blame economic issues on Trump and emphasize affordability ahead of 2026 primary[3].
